name: card_render_probe
description: rikkaST render/message-lifecycle probe card (task-4). Self-asserting via window.parent.__rikkaLog.
scenario: Probe scenario: exercise card-script iframe globals, message lifecycle events, read-only worldbook APIs and host-side regex recognition.
first_mes:
[card_render_probe] rikkaST 渲染/消息面生命周期探针卡。

本条 first_mes 内嵌占位符 [[CARD_RENDER_PROBE_REGEX_SLOT]]，卡内 regex_scripts 会在展示管线把它替换为 CARD_RENDER_PROBE_REGEX_APPLIED。
若宿主只在展示层应用正则、存储层保留原文，则 getChatMessages 里仍是原占位符（探针会如实上报，不静默）。

操作指引：编辑 / swipe / 删除任意一条消息，观察 [CARD] card_render_probe event_received 行。
creatorcomment: Probe card for rikkaST PC build. Every assertion logs '[CARD] card_render_probe <check> PASS|FAIL <detail>'.
